newsitem.title: UK: December BTP futures set new contract high.
newsitem.headline: December BTP futures set new contract high.

text.p: December BTP futures traded on the London International Financial Futures and Options Exchange (LIFFE) set a new contract high above 119.55 on Wednesday, traders said.
The contract broke through the previous 119.55 record, set on Tuesday, and pushed to a new high at 119.57.
By 0705 GMT, the contract had slipped back slight and was trading 31 basis points higher on the day at 119.48.
Technical analysts say the next target for the contract lies at 120.00
